sources.title: fect 2.4.5 selected panel estimation, weighting and inference paths
sources.author: Yiqing Xu and package contributors

inspected_anchors.finding: Version 2.4.5; MIT declaration; compiled engine requires R >=4.1, Rcpp, RcppArmadillo and listed imports.
Year and holder only, not complete license-template evidence.
Direct engine defaults differ; weight roles, fixed effects, resampling and tolerance are explicit.
Default unconstrained loading and one-standard-error CV rule; rule validation.
Jackknife ignores cluster with warning; W fills both roles, distinct role columns refused, zero weights drop rows.
gsynth forces never-treated donor pool and em FALSE; pre-period count and CV defaults depend on method.
Donor/count gates and automatic unit removals; sample retention must accompany target.
Reversals refused for gsynth; parametric inference requires isolated never-treated pool; empirical/wild errors require complete panel.
Inspected no-CV gsynth path delegates to fect_nevertreated with weights, masks and rank.
Aggregation-weight outputs enter canonical slots; fitting-only weights do not; EM iteration-limit warning.
Selected balanced/unbalanced control-fit dispatch; not a full C++ implementation audit.
Rank versus count guards can reset rank or refuse CV; counts do not prove matrix rank.
Selected parallel CV aggregation and legacy rank-update path; serial path distinct.
Final CV rule can override intermediate selection using minimum, 1SE or legacy 1pct; sentinels removed from selection.
Selected unbounded loading solve uses pre-factor Gram inverse; solve failure returns NA ATT fields.
Treated-cell average, weighted counterpart and within-unit then across-unit average have distinct denominators.
Parametric auto mode resolves to AR with missing cells, empirical otherwise.
Selected case bootstrap resamples units or cluster IDs; support-conditioned retries appear in unit branch.
Average SE uses sd with na.rm; normal CI default versus basic pivot; failed draws require explicit accounting.

supported_claims: fect distinguishes fit and aggregation weights, rejects different columns in selected source and changes canonical aggregation slots.
Treated-cell and unit averages differ; missingness and removals require explicit denominators.
Counts, predictive rank selection and a finite loading solve do not establish counterfactual stability.
Never-treated donor, reversal and inference gates have explicit source behavior; no universal bootstrap claim.
limitations: Selected original source inspection, not native R/C++ execution, a full dependency audit or measured coverage.
Pinned gsynth 1.4.0 delegates to fect; selected fect 2.4.5 is a reviewed dependency candidate, not an installed lock.
MIT + file LICENSE declarations and holder/year files are inspected; full standard template and dependency rights remain unreviewed.
No genuine local Xu 2017 original was recovered for this review; package comments are not a substitute for a scholarly paper.
Rank-two examples are authored deterministic counterexamples outside full pre-factor-rank qualification, not qualified-engine failures.
No universal missingness, dependence, factor selection, bootstrap or economic validity is established.
Rendered visual review, mandatory repairs and final proposal acceptance remain open.

sources.title: gsynth 1.4.0 compatibility wrapper and documented weight contract
sources.author: Yiqing Xu and package contributors

inspected_anchors.finding: Version 1.4.0; MIT declaration; no wrapper compilation; R >=2.10 and fect >=2.0.0 imports.
Year and holder only; full MIT template and dependency terms are not reproduced here.
Estimator routing changed in 1.4.0; 1.3.0 merged functionality into fect and retained compatibility wrapper.
Maintainers explicitly describe backward-compatibility-only maintenance.
Complete wrapper: weight is declared but unused; dispatch, inference remapping, defaults, original-data storage and class relabeling.
Manual advertises weight as weighted average effect and cluster support only for nonparametric bootstrap.
Inspected tests cover routing, result shape, seed and options; skip_on_cran; no weight assertion in these ranges. Tests not run.

supported_claims: gsynth 1.4.0 is a compatibility wrapper; selected fect 2.4.5 supplies estimation and inference.
The complete selected wrapper declares weight but neither reads nor forwards it; the manual promises a weighted effect.
Method, inference, force, CV, tolerance and output class cannot be inferred from wrapper name alone.
